name: Currency Exchange
description: Business management for a currency-exchange / money-exchange operation (bureau de change, remittance counters): rates, buy/sell transactions, cash tills, branches, and AML/KYC controls. Not a crypto trading engine — see DOMAIN.md for how crypto exchange relates as a different product type.

sources.title: bdc-api (Bureau de Change API)
sources.license: none found (no LICENSE file; all-rights-reserved by default)
sources.notes: Hobby-scale (1 star) TypeORM/Express API for a bureau de change: currency, daily_rate (buy/sell, official/market), purchase/purchasemain (buy transactions with cash-note serial ranges), selling (sell transactions with transaction_ref, buyingrate/soldrate, KYC fields mode_of_id/id_no/id_expirydate/bvn), users. Inspected via `gh api repos/.../contents` (not cloned; no license to extract under). Single implementation — evidence held at low/medium confidence per feature, never 'industry standard' on its own.

sources.title: chfx-odoo-modules (Odoo currency-exchange counter modules)
sources.license: unknown (not stated in repository; verify before any reuse)
sources.notes: Odoo addon modules (`exchange_counter`, `chfx_extension`) with real fields for exchange.branch, exchange.counter (till, linked to an accounting journal and per-currency cash accounts), exchange.session (cashier session on a counter), exchange.transaction (buy/sell with mid_rate vs used_rate vs manual_rate, margin_pct, commission, KYC required/confirmed flags, partner/client link, accounting move), exchange.rate, exchange.remittance. Inspected via `gh api repos/.../contents` (not cloned). Second independent implementation — corroborates branch/counter/session/rate/transaction/remittance as real, separately-modeled concepts.

sources.title: FATF Recommendations
sources.notes: Recommendation 20 (suspicious transaction reporting) and the customer due diligence recommendations directly govern money-or-value-transfer services and currency exchange offices as 'obliged entities' / DNFBPs in most jurisdictions.

sources.title: ISO 4217 — Currency codes
sources.license: ISO copyright; standard summary freely accessible
sources.notes: Currency code terminology for buy/sell rate pairs and cash positions.

sources.title: ISO 20022 — Universal financial industry message scheme
sources.license: ISO20022.org terms; message definitions freely published
sources.notes: Cross-border remittance/payment messaging terminology, used when an exchange house settles or receives via bank rails.

sources.title: EU Anti-Money Laundering Directive / Regulation package
sources.notes: Currency exchange offices are named obliged entities under EU AML law; cited generically — no jurisdiction-specific (e.g. Iranian) rule is asserted anywhere in this domain.

sources.title: Blnk (open-source double-entry ledger)
sources.notes: On-disk clone (see sources/domains/blnk/SOURCE.md). Real double-entry ledger with explicit Transaction, Balance, Identity, and a standalone reconciliation.go engine (reconciliation_matching_test.go, reconciliation_rules_test.go) plus transaction_refunds.go/transaction_refund.go modelling refund as a first-class reversal of a posted transaction. Not bureau-de-change-specific, but a real, on-disk, Apache-2.0 implementation of settlement reconciliation and transaction refund/reversal as domain concepts in a financial ledger.

sources.title: Moov Watchman (sanctions/PEP screening engine)
sources.notes: Inspected via `gh api` (not cloned). Actively maintained, production-used open-source sanctions/PEP screening engine: ingests OFAC SDN/Non-SDN, US CSL, FinCEN 311, EU/UK/UN consolidated lists and OpenSanctions data, scores each candidate 0-1 with an inspectable multi-field matcher (name, alias, government ID, DOB, address). Concretely evidences exchange.sanctions_screening and the sanctions_watchlist_screening integration as a real, separately-built concern distinct from generic identity verification.

sources.title: Moov Customers (KYC/CIP customer registry)
sources.notes: Inspected via `gh api` (not cloned). A customer registry purpose-built for KYC/Customer Identification Program plus OFAC checks; its own docs (docs/watchman.md) and migrations (create_customer_ofac_searches, create_account_ofac_searches) show identity verification and sanctions screening modelled as linked but distinct concerns, corroborating the same split used in this domain's exchange.kyc_thresholds vs exchange.sanctions_screening.

sources.title: Moov ACH (Automated Clearing House file reader/writer)
sources.notes: Inspected via `gh api` (not cloned). Real, actively maintained reader/writer/validator for US ACH bank-transfer files; evidences the bank_transfer_rail integration as a concrete, separately-implemented concern.

sources.title: Moov ISO 20022 (financial messaging library)
sources.notes: Inspected via `gh api` (not cloned). Open-source implementation of ISO 20022 message parsing/generation; corroborates the iso20022 authoritative source with a concrete implementation for the bank_transfer_rail integration.

sources.title: PCI DSS v4.0.1
sources.license: PCI Security Standards Council public standard
sources.notes: Governs any card acquiring/card-funded flow an exchange business adds on top of its cash/bank-transfer core.

sources.title: EU Regulation (EU) 2023/1113 — Transfer of Funds Regulation (recast, 'travel rule')
sources.notes: Implements FATF Recommendation 16 in the EU: requires complete originator/beneficiary information to accompany a transfer of funds. Directly relevant to exchange.remittance and any bank-rail settlement leg.

sources.title: FinCEN — Money Services Business (MSB) Registration
sources.notes: US currency dealers/exchangers and money transmitters must register with FinCEN as MSBs and maintain an agent list. Cited generically for the US as one jurisdiction's implementation of the obliged-entity concept, not as a universal rule.

sources.title: HMRC — Anti-Money Laundering Guidance for Supervised Businesses: Money Service Business sector guidance (AMLG2400)
sources.version: AMLG2400, under the Money Laundering Regulations 2017
sources.notes: UK currency exchange, money transmission, and cheque-cashing businesses register with HMRC under MLR 2017 (or need separate FCA authorisation for payment services). Cited generically for the UK, not as a universal rule.

sources.title: The Wolfsberg Group — Financial Crime Principles for Correspondent Banking (2022)
sources.notes: Industry (non-binding) due-diligence principles relevant when an exchange/remittance business relies on a correspondent bank or network partner to settle cross-border transfers.

features.name: Customer / Party Management
features.description: Maintain walk-in and repeat customer records for an exchange business, including individuals and corporate clients.

features.name: Currency Master Data
features.description: The list of currencies an exchange business trades, with display codes and precision.

features.name: Buy/Sell Rate & Spread Management
features.description: Set and update buy and sell rates per currency pair, including the spread margin, either manually or from a rate source.

provenance.notes: Both implementations model buy/sell rates explicitly; bdc-api additionally splits official vs market rate. Downgraded high→medium on 2026-09-27: fewer than 3 implementations and no authoritative source.

features.name: Rate Source Feed Ingestion
features.description: Pull reference/mid-market rates from an external market-data source to seed or sanity-check manual rates.

provenance.notes: chfx-odoo-modules integrates a named external rate source (Frankfurter) and stores a mid_rate distinct from the applied rate; single implementation for this specific sub-feature.

features.name: Exchange Requests / Quotes
features.description: A customer or teller requests a quote to buy or sell a currency before committing to the transaction.

provenance.notes: Both implementations go straight to a committed transaction; a distinct pre-commit 'quote' step is a reasoned refinement, not separately modeled in either source.

features.name: Buy/Sell Transactions
features.description: Execute a currency purchase from, or sale to, a customer at a locked-in rate, updating cash positions and the ledger.

provenance.notes: Downgraded high→medium on 2026-09-27: fewer than 3 implementations and no authoritative source.

features.name: Remittance / Money Transfer
features.description: Send or receive a cross-border money transfer on behalf of a customer, typically via a remittance network partner.

provenance.notes: Modeled as a distinct exchange.remittance record in chfx-odoo-modules; not present in bdc-api, held at medium via a single implementation plus FATF's explicit coverage of money-or-value-transfer services.

features.name: Tills / Cash Drawers & Cash Positions
features.description: Track each teller's till (cash drawer) balance per currency, opened and closed once per cashier session.

provenance.notes: chfx-odoo-modules models counter+session with per-currency cash accounts explicitly; single implementation, not present in bdc-api.

features.name: Branch Management
features.description: Manage physical branch/counter locations a multi-site exchange business operates from.

provenance.notes: exchange.branch is explicit in chfx-odoo-modules; single implementation but a near-universal concept for any multi-counter cash business, so held at medium rather than low.

features.name: Staff / Teller Management
features.description: Manage teller and manager accounts, their assigned branch/till, and shift scheduling.

features.name: Receipts & Payment Vouchers
features.description: Print or email a receipt/voucher for a completed exchange or remittance transaction.

provenance.notes: bdc-api generates a transaction_ref at insert time; chfx-odoo-modules independently ships an explicit exchange_receipt_report.xml print template (chfx_extension/reports/) alongside an exchange_invoice_report.xml. Two independent implementations corroborate receipt/voucher generation as a real, separately-built feature; raised low -> medium on 2026-09-27.

features.name: KYC with Transaction Thresholds
features.description: Require identity capture above a configured transaction-amount threshold, and stronger due diligence above a second, higher threshold.

provenance.notes: bdc-api's selling entity captures mode_of_id/id_no/id_expirydate/bvn per transaction; the specific threshold amount is not in either source and must be set per jurisdiction/policy.

features.name: AML Reporting (Suspicious / Large Transaction Reports)
features.description: Flag and file suspicious-transaction or large-cash-transaction reports with the relevant authority.

provenance.notes: Reporting obligation itself is authoritative (FATF R.20); no OSS implementation reviewed models an STR case workflow, so the workflow shape is reasoned.

features.name: Transaction Audit Log
features.description: Immutable, time-stamped record of every rate change, transaction, and cash-session action for later audit.

features.name: Reports & Analytics
features.description: Daily/periodic reports on volume, profit/margin, cash positions, and branch performance.

provenance.notes: chfx-odoo-modules computes profit_chf/margin_pct per transaction, implying a rollup report; the report layer itself is reasoned.

features.name: Customer Notifications
features.description: Notify a customer by SMS/email when a remittance is ready for pickup or a rate alert threshold is hit.

provenance.notes: Reasoned inference from the remittance model; no notification feature directly observed in either source.

features.name: Online Rate Lookup / Order-Ahead
features.description: Let a customer look up current rates and reserve/order a currency amount online for branch pickup.

provenance.notes: Reasoned inference; bdc-api exposes a currency/rate API a storefront could read from, but no order-ahead flow is modeled.

features.name: Commission & Fee Management
features.description: Configure a commission or flat fee on top of the exchanged amount, per currency, branch, or channel.

provenance.notes: commission_chf and commission_account_id are explicit fields; single implementation.

features.name: Sanctions / PEP Watchlist Screening
features.description: Screen a customer, beneficiary, or counterparty against sanctions, PEP, and other watchlists before or during onboarding and before a remittance is paid out.

provenance.notes: FATF Recommendation 6 (targeted financial sanctions) is authoritative; moov-io/watchman is a real, actively-maintained, Apache-2.0 screening engine (OFAC/EU/UK/UN/OpenSanctions, scored matching) and moov-io/customers pairs a KYC registry with the same screening — two independent implementations plus an authoritative source. Not observed in bdc-api or chfx-odoo-modules, which have KYC capture fields but no screening step.

features.name: Settlement & Cash Reconciliation
features.description: Reconcile a branch's or period's completed transactions and cash positions against bank statements or the accounting ledger, matching entries and flagging discrepancies.

provenance.notes: blnk (on-disk, Apache-2.0) ships a standalone reconciliation.go matching engine with dedicated rule and matching tests; chfx-odoo-modules links every exchange.transaction to an account.move (accounting journal entry) per counter. blnk is a general ledger, not bureau-de-change-specific, so this is corroboration of the reconciliation mechanism, not of a bureau-de-change-specific reconciliation feature; held at medium rather than high.

features.name: Transaction Refunds & Cancellations
features.description: Cancel a not-yet-settled exchange request or transaction, or reverse a completed transaction with a refund, restoring the till position.

provenance.notes: bdc-api/chfx-odoo-modules model a pre-settlement draft/voided or draft/cancel state (cancellation); blnk (on-disk, Apache-2.0) separately models a post-completion refund as a first-class transaction reversal (transaction_refunds.go, transaction_refund.go/_test.go). blnk is a general ledger, not a bureau-de-change implementation, so this corroborates the refund mechanism generally rather than this exact vertical; held at medium.

features.name: Remittance Beneficiary Management
features.description: Save and reuse a remittance recipient's details across multiple sends for a customer, instead of re-entering them every time.

provenance.notes: chfx-odoo-modules' exchange.remittance model has a plain beneficiary_name text field, not a separate reusable beneficiary entity; a full saved-beneficiary CRUD feature is a reasoned expansion of that one field, evidenced by a single implementation. Not present in bdc-api.

features.name: Transaction & Velocity Limits
features.description: Configure per-transaction, daily, and monthly limits on a customer's exchange or remittance activity, distinct from the one-off KYC identity-capture threshold, to catch structuring/velocity patterns.

provenance.notes: Reasoned inference from FATF's CDD-threshold and suspicious-activity-monitoring language; neither bdc-api nor chfx-odoo-modules models a configurable limit distinct from the KYC ID-capture threshold, and no separate OSS implementation of velocity limiting was found for this vertical.
